# fopost_workspace (Data Source)

Reads one FoPost workspace and the social accounts connected to it. Use it to reference a workspace this configuration does not manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fopost_workspace" "acme" {
  id = "ws_01hzy8example"
}

output "connected_platforms" {
  value = [for account in data.fopost_workspace.acme.accounts : account.platform]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the workspace to read.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) Social accounts connected to the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the workspace was created.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the workspace.
- `language` (String) Primary content language as an ISO 639-1 code.
- `logo` (String) URL of the workspace logo.
- `name` (String) Display name of the workspace.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier of the workspace.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone scheduled posts are read in.
- `type` (String) What the workspace represents, e.g. `TEAM` or `AGENCY`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the workspace.
- `website` (String) The brand's website.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `avatar` (String) URL of the account's avatar.
- `id` (String) The account's identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name on the platform.
- `platform` (String) The social network the account is on.
- `username` (String) Handle on the platform.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the account belongs to.
